Both render cleanly, no errors, and marking a status works. Here are the two ways of separating **to-read** from **finished** — identical except for that separation. I've pre-set a mix of statuses so there's something in each group.

---

### 👉 Please try both

**Variant 1 — filter tabs · http://maker:4001/status-a.html**
Up top you'll see tabs: **All / To read / Finished** (with counts). Click **To read** — the list shows only those; click **Finished** — only those. One list at a time, you switch between them.

**Variant 2 — grouped sections · http://maker:4001/status-b.html**
Here everything is on one page in two labelled groups: a **📖 To read** section, then a **✓ Finished** section below it. You see both at once, scrolling between them.

**In either variant**, on any card click **"Mark as finished"** (or *"Mark as to read"*) and watch the bookmark's status change and move to the right group/tab. Search and tag-browsing still work in both.

---

Two things I decided — please check:
- **How you change status:** a single button on each card that flips it between *To read* and *Finished*. (A bookmark is always one or the other.)
- **Starting statuses:** I pre-set the mix just so both groups have contents.

**Which separation feels right for you — the switchable tabs (1) or the two-groups-on-one-page (2)?** And does marking something read/unread this way match what you intended?
